_comment: The collection coverage ratchet. Each collection's mapped and live percentages (of its contract's operations in scope, from coverage/collections/<collection>) may not drop below these floors; internal/archtest's TestCoverageLedgers enforces it, and docs/reference/coverage shows the numbers. Raise a floor in the change that raises the percentage. Lowering one needs a written reason under _exceptions. A collection with no floor is reported, not failed.
